skill.name: gwas-database
skill.description: Query the NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog for SNP-trait associations, study metadata, traits, genes, and summary statistics.
skill.summary: Find GWAS Catalog variants, traits, studies, p-values, and summary statistics for genetic epidemiology research.
skill.author: K-Dense-AI

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown backticks and intended examples accessing public NHGRI-EBI GWAS endpoints. Confirmed risks are limited to FTP or plain HTTP summary-statistics downloads and local file writing without integrity or path safeguards. No prompt injection or malicious exfiltration language was found.

remediation.issue: FTP and plain HTTP download examples lack transport security.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer HTTPS API or web download paths. If FTP is unavoidable, require checksums or signatures before using downloaded data.

remediation.issue: Downloaded files are written without path validation or overwrite controls.
remediation.suggestion: Validate GCST identifiers, constrain output paths to a user-approved directory, and avoid overwriting existing files by default.

remediation.issue: Network examples do not consistently mention operational safeguards.
remediation.suggestion: Add timeouts, pagination limits, caching, rate limiting, and an allowlist for GWAS Catalog domains in executable examples.

static_findings.snippet: - Avoid hammering the API with rapid consecutive requests
- Variant IDs: `rs` numbers (e.g., rs7903146) or `variant_id` format
- `size` parameter: Number of results per page
- `_links` in response: URLs for next/previous pages

content.value_statement: Genetic association searches often require many identifiers and endpoints. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through GWAS Catalog lookups with clear research outputs.
actual_capabilities: Search GWAS Catalog associations by rs ID, trait, disease, gene, study, or genomic region.
Explain REST API endpoints for studies, variants, traits, associations, publications, and genes.
Retrieve key association fields such as p-values, effect sizes, risk alleles, traits, and study accessions.
Guide access to summary statistics through the API, web portal, or documented bulk download paths.
Support reproducible literature reviews with search strategy, pagination, metadata, and access-date notes.
limitations: The skill depends on public GWAS Catalog availability and current API behavior.
It does not provide clinical diagnosis, personal risk prediction, or medical advice.
Large summary statistics files may require storage planning and integrity checks.
Reported associations need expert review for ancestry, study design, and genome build context.

use_cases.title: Variant Evidence Review
use_cases.description: Look up a SNP and summarize traits, p-values, genes, and publication metadata from GWAS Catalog records.

use_cases.title: Trait Association Search
use_cases.description: Find genome-wide significant variants for a disease or phenotype and prepare a structured evidence summary.

use_cases.title: Summary Statistics Planning
use_cases.description: Identify studies with full summary statistics and plan secure, documented data access for downstream analysis.

prompt_templates.title: Look Up a Variant
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the GWAS Catalog skill to summarize known associations for rs7903146. Include traits, p-values, mapped genes, and study accessions.

prompt_templates.title: Search a Trait
prompt_templates.prompt: Find genome-wide significant associations for type 2 diabetes in the GWAS Catalog. Group results by variant and report study metadata.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Gene Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: For APOE, identify nearby GWAS Catalog variants linked to Alzheimer disease. Include effect direction when available and note ancestry context.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Reproducible Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a reproducible GWAS Catalog search plan for body mass index. Include REST endpoints, pagination strategy, filters, and citation fields.

output_examples.output: A concise association summary with traits, strongest allele, p-values, mapped genes, PMID, and GWAS Catalog study accession.
A grouped evidence summary listing top variants, reported traits, publication metadata, ancestry notes, and interpretation caveats.
A documented access plan with source endpoint, file size concerns, integrity checks, license notes, and reproducibility fields.

best_practices: Record the GWAS Catalog access date and cite study accessions or PubMed IDs.
Use pagination, delays, and caching for broad API searches.
Check ancestry, sample size, genome build, and study design before interpreting associations.
anti_patterns: Do not treat GWAS associations as clinical recommendations.
Do not mix genome builds or coordinate systems without documenting conversion steps.
Do not download bulk summary statistics without checking license, size, and integrity.

faq.question: Does this skill need an API key?
faq.answer: No. The referenced GWAS Catalog APIs are open access, but users should respect service limits.

faq.question: Can it search by rs ID?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for variant details and associations for specific rs identifiers.

faq.question: Can it interpret personal disease risk?
faq.answer: No. It supports research lookup. Clinical interpretation requires qualified review and appropriate consent.

faq.question: Does it cover summary statistics?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains API and bulk access patterns, including cautions for large files.

faq.question: What sources does it use?
faq.answer: It focuses on the NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog, the Summary Statistics API, and official documentation.

faq.question: Can results change over time?
faq.answer: Yes. The GWAS Catalog is updated, so reports should include the access date and identifiers.
